property_summary: If createArtFromFactory(call) does not revert then tokenIdCounter increases (returns a larger value) after the call than before.
If createArtFromFactory returns (does not revert) then getTokenIdFromFactoryArtId(artId) becomes nonzero (a tokenId was assigned).

If createArtFromFactory(artId) succeeds (does not revert) when called by the factory (this contract is treated as factory), then getTokenIdFromFactoryArtId(artId) returns a tokenId strictly greater than or equal to the tokenIdCounter value observed before the call (i.e., a new assigned tokenId >= previous counter).
